scripts.build: pnpm --filter @inkpage/format build && pnpm --filter @inkpage/ui build && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop build
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop package:dir
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop package:linux
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop package:win
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop package:mac
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm --filter @inkpage/desktop package:linux
